hooks.command: cd "$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')).cwd" 2>/dev/null || echo "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR")" && cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && { [ -e .claude/skills/tdd ] || npx -y skills@latest add mattpocock/skills -a claude-code -y --skill $(node -p "Object.keys(require('./skills-lock.json').skills).join(' ')") >/dev/null 2>&1; }
